spec.method: per predicted (era, drop): remove the k worst months for k=1..8 under four rules (|gap_bp|, |delta_sum|, first k, last k in month order), recompute both era readings with _drop_effect_both_bp, and report the k at which the two readings stop disagreeing in sign
spec.units: era effects in bp; k in months

class_rules.no_era_reversal: the two readings already agree with nothing removed
class_rules.era_property: still disagreeing after k_max months removed

honest: the month rows are read from the published E186 face and every k recomputes both era readings from them, so a missing face publishes zero pairs rather than an invented curve

the four trim rules are not interchangeable orderings of one thing: ranking by |gap| removes the months that move the LEVEL, ranking by |delta_sum| removes the months that move the ADDITIVE path, and the first/last rules ask whether the verdict is an edge-of-window effect
k is capped at min(k_max, months-2) so a short era cannot be trimmed down to one observation and read as agreement
removing months changes the sample the verdict is computed on; this measures fragility, it does not license dropping any month for real
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
